[engine] Read an instrument's call graph and its guards before specifying or trusting it. 'How often does this mechanism run' answers whether the mechanism EXISTS, never how often the STATE moves; and a probe that is never allowlisted has never been run through the launcher at all, so its verdict is a no-op mistaken for a negative result. When you replace a degenerate instrument, check the replacement for the same two defects -- it is usually degenerate the same way.

<!-- lesson_id: eng-mh-0009 | class: measurement-hygiene | superseded_by: - -->

**class**: `measurement-hygiene`

## 為什麼（because）

Three instruments were checked before writing one line of the measurement D3 depends on, and all three failed on one of those two axes. (1) The instrument §9.17(d) specified -- publish_slot_table call count per decode step -- is degenerate by construction: both of its call sites are inside the S1 remap hook itself (llama-context.cpp:5448 and :5584) and the header comment says it is 'reached only from the S1 path', so the answer is 0 on the baseline arm and once per served layer on S1. It measures mechanism presence, not state velocity -- exactly the defect §9.17(d) had already diagnosed in the CGC-SLOT-TABLE clamp count it was supposed to replace, repeated by the replacement. (2) The cheapest existing churn proxy, LLAMA_EXPERT_CACHE_STEP_DBG, had never been in run_server.sh's allowlist, which is an explicit list passed through `env "${SERVER_ENV[@]}"` rather than a prefix rule; so the diagnostic quoted in-code as the source of the 2026-08-28 'structural churn' verdict could not be enabled through the launcher, and every attempt since was a silent no-op indistinguishable from 'the change had no effect' -- the trap the same file already documents for NOHOOK/NOGATHER. (3) With that fixed and verified (dry run shows ENV LLAMA_EXPERT_CACHE_STEP_DBG=1 reaching the launch line), the probe still produced zero lines on a prod25 (MTP off) decode, because its block sits inside `if ((verify_fast || draft_fast) && cgc_fast_eligible)` and every step reported `CGC-WARM ... fast=0`. The zero was a dead end, not a zero churn: the instrument's guard, not the phenomenon, decided the reading.

## 反例（counterexample_observed）

A zero line count that reads as 'no churn' while the block was in fact never entered -- the same shape as the CGC-SLOT-TABLE 0-line count and as CGC_IDS_CAPTURE before it was allowlisted.
